scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @raf/mcp build && concurrently -k -n MCP,API,WEB -c magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @raf/mcp build:watch" "pnpm --filter @raf/api start:dev" "pnpm --filter @raf/web dev"
